channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: Learning When to Stop: Fast Readout for Atom Arrays
item.description: Adaptive photon counting lets neutral-atom processors read out qubits in microseconds, signaling each atom only until its state is clear.

item.title: Turning Classical Noise into Quantum Channels
item.description: Classical probability clouds cross a square-root bridge into Lindblad quantum channels, where decoherence replaces diffusion.

item.title: Finding the Bell Curve in Quantum States
item.description: Repeatedly mixing quantum states through a beam splitter washes out their differences, drawing them toward stabilizer states—the discrete bell curves of the quantum world.

item.title: A Lone Qubit Learns Signals Exponentially Faster
item.description: A single superconducting qubit learns signal properties exponentially faster than conventional Gaussian sensors, using quantum coherence as a powerful sensing resource.
